name: the business plan document
source: A blank business plan template, delivered as pasted text in conversation. Landed verbatim at fold-matrix/sources/blank_template_pasted.md. Nine sections plus a Tips section.
_note: NOT the SBA blank traditional template the order named. Measured: 1 of
its 9 section names appears in the two filled SBA plans (Executive
Summary), and of twelve SBA headings only three appear here, two of
them as incidental phrases in other sections. So the registered P1,
P3 and P4 remain NOT ADDRESSABLE for the file they were registered
against, and this is a new candidate.
PROVENANCE ASYMMETRY, recorded: the two filled plans arrived as .doc
files with a container, a piece table, an author line and a creation
date. This arrived as text with none of those -- no author, no date,
no file. It is a weaker artifact in a way nothing in its content
TWO READINGS OF THE TERM, and they disagree. A blank template has no
business activity in it, so under the reading WO8 uses for the filled
plans -- term = the thing the business does -- level 0 is a SLOT and
the grid is not constructible at all. This grid takes the other
reading: the term is the DOCUMENT. Both are stated; neither is picked.
_enumeration_note: the levels are the template's own sections and its own statements about what each is for; nothing added from outside it

plan.why: the document is a template FOR a plan, so a plan exists in the document set in the weakest possible sense: as a form. Whether any filled instance tracks it is not readable from the blank.

levels.severed: the business's actual quantities -- revenue, cost, cash
levels.still_acting: nothing yet: there is no business behind a blank form

quantified.by: the template NAMES all of these -- Revenue Projections, Cash Flow Statement, Balance Sheet, Break-even Analysis, Net Profit, COGS, TAM, SAM, SOM -- and computes none. Naming a quantity and computing it are different acts, and this document does the first nine times.

levels.severed: any figure and the thing it would measure

quantified.by: ten dollar figures appear and ALL TEN are inside an '(e.g., ...)' -- $5 billion, $1M, $500,000, $10 Billion, $2 Billion, $50 Million, $200,000, $150,000, $100,000, $50,000 -- plus two slot markers '$[Price]'. A fourth kind beyond FM_024's three: not the org's, not a third party's, not an external statistic. An EXAMPLE of a quantity, belonging to nobody, computed by nobody.

quantified.by: the template computes no quantity anywhere
